THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
077
STUDY 056
Black Turtleneck & Pleated Mini
Rights check
Source: 24395.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
and bangs, wearing black rectangular glasses, walks a
runway. She wears a fitted black ribbed turtleneck with
a small red emblem, a black pleated mini skirt with a
cream ruffled hem, and sheer black tights. A black
structured bag hangs from one shoulder, and she
wears black mary-jane heels. Her expression is calm
and direct. A saturated blue runway backdrop with soft,
even light. Palette of black, cream, and cobalt blue.
Sharp and graphic, in the style of a minimalist runway
show.
Sharp, graphic, minimal
WORKING NOTES
- The glasses and cream ruffled hem are the unexpected
touches.
- Keep the blue backdrop for a graphic contrast.
